newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TWO PREMIER LEAGUE MATCHES OFF AS ICE BITES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TWO PREMIER LEAGUE MATCHES OFF AS ICE BITES.

text.p: Two of Wednesday's premier league soccer matches have been posponed and others could follow as snow and ice bite into the new year's day programme.
Leicester's match against Tottenham and Derby's fixture with Sheffield Wednesday were called off on Tuesday as well as several in the lower divisions.
Motherwell's match against Kilmarnock became the first premier division casualty in Scotland and in division two only Livingstone's match with Berwick remains.
Derby's game was called off on police advice, with manager Jim Smith saying: "There is no problem with the pitch but the approach roads to the ground are treacherous.
England's top of division one clash between Sheffield United and Wolves is one of a number of matches that have bowed to the weather.
